overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to have the chair announce that its June 17 meeting was being recorded, but found the Board's remedial steps appropriate and ordered no further relief.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Ware Board of Health failed to announce at its June 17 meeting that the meeting was being recorded.
allegations.key_passage: Because the chair did not make this announcement at the beginning of the meeting, we find a violation of the Law.
